arguments.command:
git commit -q --amend --no-verify -m "ci: check the commits of each pull request with commitlint

The commitlint job runs commitlint.config.js over the commits between
the base and the head of the pull request. Unlike a commit-msg hook,
git commit --no-verify cannot skip it, so the rule applies to everyone,
pi included. knip now sees @commitlint/cli in use, so drop it from
ignoreDependencies.

Refs #38" && npx --no -- commitlint --from origin/main --to HEAD 2>&1 | grep -c "found 0 problems, 0 warnings"; git push -q -u origin feat/38-no-agent-hooks 2>&1 | tail -2
